files.description: Full HTML of the main EHI export documentation page (WordPress/Elementor). Contains export format descriptions: C-CDA clinical data and CSV patient details, plus a commented-out Section 4 about document exports.

WordPress JSON API response for the main EHI export page. Contains the rendered HTML content, page metadata (created 2023-09-19, modified 2025-12-05), and WP API links. Cleaner than the full HTML for parsing.

Full HTML of the EHI data dictionary page. Contains 3 table schemas (Patients: 19 cols, Insurance: 29 cols, Appointments: 13 cols) with column names, data types, defaults, and nullability constraints.
WordPress JSON API response for the data dictionary page. Contains the rendered HTML content with all 3 table schemas, page metadata (created 2025-12-05, modified 2025-12-06).
Full-page browser screenshot of the main EHI export documentation page showing the hero banner, CDA format section, Patient Details Data section, and Notes section.
Full-page browser screenshot of the data dictionary page showing all three table schemas (Patients, Insurance, Appointments) with their column definitions.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the WP JSON API responses and extracts structured table schemas and export page content into queryable JSON.
Extracted data dictionary: 3 tables (Patients, Insurance, Appointments) with 61 total columns, each with name, dataType, defaultValue, and notNull fields.
Extracted EHI export page content: structured sections with headings, content items, links, and the commented-out Section 4 about document exports.
Enrichment accounting: 2 input files parsed, 3 tables extracted, 61 columns, 6 export sections, 1 commented-out section.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
